properties.NAME: MILLER (Ark., orig)
properties.CHANGE: MILLER (Ark., original, extinct) lost to Indian lands when treaty between the U.S. and Cherokee Indians established the western line of Arkansas Territory north of Red Riv. along the eastern line of the Choctaw Session.
properties.CITATION: (U.S. Stat., vol. 7, p. 311; Royce, 720-721; Van Zandt, 119; Ark. Terr. Acts 1828, spec. sess./pp. 9-10)
